purpose: Bounded cold-prefill NEON int8 tile-six experiment, selected after diagnostic projection share of 87.56%.
workload: One 2049-token prompt copied from first cold lifecycle request; max_tokens 1; no decode forward; synthetic token IDs, real Llama 3.2 1B int8 weights.
configuration: Four Rayon workers; prefill chunks 32 and per-step budget 32; prefix cache and shared-prefix attention off; 192 blocks of 16; maximum batch 8.

ordinary_comparison.primary: Whole replay elapsed_ms, with engine prefill_ms corroboration; one request TTFT and prompt tokens per second; retain every run.
ordinary_comparison.verification: Compare full generated tokens and terminal outcomes against first tile 4 run; kernel bitwise parity separately covers arithmetic.
ordinary_comparison.decision: Exploratory only: retain opt-in 6 if all 3 pairs improve cold latency without correctness failure; otherwise preserve patch/results and revert candidate. Defaults remain 4 in either case. No shared-attention gate inference from these timings.
ordinary_comparison.host_controls: No other tests, builds, or benchmarks alongside timing. Desktop applications remain running; host load and thermal drift uncontrolled.
